events.subtitle: Live at The Stone — Album Release
events.factual_description: The Jazz Gallery presents Kevin Hays on September 11 and 12, 2026 for four intimate duo sets celebrating the release of Kevin Hays: Live at The Stone on AHT RECORDS NYC. Hays performs with Kenny Wollesen at 7:00 PM and Ben Wendel at 9:00 PM on September 11, then with Gilad Hekselman at 7:00 PM and Craig Taborn at 9:00 PM on September 12. Hays's official site states that the album documents duet performances recorded during his 2024 residency at The Stone and that these Jazz Gallery dates are the two special release performances preceding the album's September 13 release. AHT Records lists the four album tracks as pairings with Wollesen, Taborn, Hekselman and Wendel.

en.why_it_matters: The album-release idea changes shape four times in two nights: Hays meets Wollesen's elastic percussion, Wendel's horn line, Hekselman's guitar counterpoint and, finally, Taborn in a two-keyboard conversation. Because the record itself grew out of duet encounters at The Stone, these are not interchangeable guests bolted onto a release show; the changing pairings are the musical argument. It is an unusually clean way to hear how one pianist's rhythmic and harmonic identity bends around four very different improvisers.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is in reach, actively make room for the pairing that most interests you—or take both sets on one night and hear the contrast directly. The run is strong enough to anchor a New York evening, especially alongside another reason for the corridor trip, without needing the entire trip to depend on one set.

es.why_it_matters: La idea del lanzamiento cambia de forma cuatro veces en dos noches: Hays se cruza con la percusión elástica de Wollesen, la línea de sax de Wendel, el contrapunto de guitarra de Hekselman y, al final, una conversación de dos teclados con Taborn. Como el propio disco nació de encuentros a dúo en The Stone, no son invitados intercambiables pegados a una fecha de lanzamiento: el cambio de pareja es el argumento musical. Es una forma particularmente nítida de escuchar cómo la identidad rítmica y armónica de un pianista se dobla frente a cuatro improvisadores muy distintos.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York está al alcance, le haría espacio activamente a la pareja que más te interese —o tomaría los dos sets de una misma noche para escuchar el contraste de frente—. La corrida tiene peso suficiente para anclar una noche en la ciudad, sobre todo si comparte el viaje por el corredor con otra buena razón, sin hacer depender todo el trayecto de un solo set.
